headline: ShelfMitra's Kolkata push gains a Bengali beta and Salt Lake office while StockSathi's rating falls to 3.9 [ShelfMitra-3-5] [ShelfMitra-3-1] [StockSathi-3-1]
tl_dr: ShelfMitra opened a Salt Lake Sector V office to serve West Bengal retailers [ShelfMitra-3-5] and launched Bengali language support in beta on 2026-10-20 [ShelfMitra-3-1].
ShelfMitra's 15 open Kolkata sales roles are unchanged from week 2, so the field hiring push continues [ShelfMitra-3-3].
StockSathi's app-store rating fell from 4.3 to 3.9 across 18,665 reviews, with confusing duplicate UPI Udhaar reminders as the top complaint [StockSathi-3-1].
StockSathi's 2026-10-21 fix removes duplicate UPI Udhaar reminders [StockSathi-3-3]; its ₹699 Pro stays ₹100 below our ₹799 Dukaan plan [StockSathi-3-2].
BahiBook added a Pune Product Manager opening for GST e-invoicing and fixed Devanagari name search in its ledger [BahiBook-3-3] [BahiBook-3-2].
since_last_week: Threat levels: ShelfMitra stays high [ShelfMitra-3-1] [ShelfMitra-3-5]; StockSathi moves from high to medium [StockSathi-3-2] [StockSathi-3-3]; BahiBook stays low [BahiBook-3-3].

New this week: ShelfMitra's Bengali beta [ShelfMitra-3-1] and Salt Lake office [ShelfMitra-3-5]; StockSathi's rating drop to 3.9 and duplicate-reminder fix [StockSathi-3-1] [StockSathi-3-3]; BahiBook's Pune Product Manager opening and ledger search fix [BahiBook-3-3] [BahiBook-3-2].

Unchanged: published prices for all three competitors [StockSathi-3-2] [ShelfMitra-3-2] [BahiBook-3-1]; ShelfMitra's Kolkata and Mumbai roles [ShelfMitra-3-3] [ShelfMitra-3-4]; StockSathi's careers page [StockSathi-3-4]; BahiBook's Pune Customer Support opening [BahiBook-3-4].

threats.rationale: StockSathi's Pro plan at ₹699 undercuts KiranaCloud's ₹799 Dukaan plan [StockSathi-3-2], and its UPI Udhaar reminder fix [StockSathi-3-3] addresses the rating drop to 3.9 [StockSathi-3-1], so the price gap is standing pressure rather than a new escalation.

ShelfMitra opened a Salt Lake Sector V office to serve West Bengal retailers [ShelfMitra-3-5] and launched Bengali language support in beta [ShelfMitra-3-1], both new, credible, high-impact moves into KiranaCloud's Kolkata home market.

BahiBook's new Pune Product Manager opening for GST e-invoicing [BahiBook-3-3] overlaps KiranaCloud's Q1 roadmap, but it is a single hire with medium impact and no shipped feature, and the ledger search fix [BahiBook-3-2] is low impact.

recommendations.action: Scope a Bengali-language option for KiranaCloud's Kolkata accounts, since ShelfMitra's Bengali beta is already live.
Add the Salt Lake Sector V office and West Bengal retailers to the top-200 Kolkata account coverage plan.
Hold StockSathi reminder-confusion messaging until the 2026-10-21 fix is confirmed in the field, then use it in comparisons.

watchlist: Whether StockSathi's rating stays near 3.9 after the duplicate-reminder fix [StockSathi-3-1] [StockSathi-3-3].
Whether ShelfMitra's Salt Lake office leads to hiring beyond the 15 current Kolkata sales roles [ShelfMitra-3-5] [ShelfMitra-3-3].
Whether BahiBook's Pune GST e-invoicing Product Manager opening signals a product push [BahiBook-3-3].
discounted_claims: StockSathi-3-5: an unverified Startup Gupshup blog post (credibility 0.2) claims an unnamed large e-commerce player is acquiring StockSathi; no company has confirmed it.
